task:
You answer questions about 3GPP RAN3 standardization records using only a full-text search tool over the source text for RAN3: the text of the working-group source documents (meeting-report excerpts, change requests and contributions) as extracted from the files, and the TSG plenary archive documents for the same period. No extracted metadata or labels are shown or searched; a result header shows only its source, an identifier, the document kind and, when the file name carries one, the document number. Run the tool from the repository root with Bash:
  PYTHONPATH=scripts/common:scripts/publication/paper/ongoing/sigir-2027-research python3 scripts/publication/paper/ongoing/sigir-2027-research/search_raw_text.py --wg RAN3 [--query "<withheld sha256=362240f1056e28de0d48d186c00e362252f4ec5298a619ea02d336b05023176b chars=5>" [--doc NUMBER] [--source wg|plenary|both] [--top N] [--chars N] [--raw]
--query "<withheld sha256=1f64fff08d787e732e04559f4d241876b399d9d4251af79833bd22adbb2d331a chars=4>" a BM25 search over the text; --raw passes an FTS5 MATCH expression; --doc keeps only text from the file with exactly that document number (R3-... or RP-...); --source chooses the working-group documents, the plenary documents or both; --chars 0 prints whole chunks. You may search as many times as you need and follow any identifier you read. Do not open any other file, database, graph or service. Answer with a JSON object {"rows": [[...], ...]}. Each row lists the requested fields in this order: <the item's fields>. Use document numbers, meeting names and clause numbers exactly as written in the records (for example R4-2205027, RAN4#102-e, RP-221234, RAN#96, 6.2.1). Disposition values are lower-case codes such as agreed, revised, noted, endorsed, withdrawn, not_pursued. If the records hold no such row, answer {"rows": []}.
